editorial.blurb: Southside African Restaurant brings authentic, boldly seasoned African cuisine to a vibrant, casual spot where regulars keep coming back for the smoky rice dishes and tender grilled meats.
editorial.insiderTip: Order online ahead of time during busy hours to skip the line, or go during off-peak times for a more relaxed experience.

topDishes.note: smoky, spicy rice with tender chicken that reviewers loved
